note: Entirely fictional. Orchard Works, its employees, employee numbers, devices and every reference are invented for this teaching build.

unlock_account.label: unlocking the sign-in account
unlock_account.done: The sign-in account is unlocked. The password is unchanged.

reset_password.label: a password reset
reset_password.done: A password reset link went to the recovery address registered to the account. No password is set or read out on this call.

move_authenticator.label: moving the authenticator to a new phone
move_authenticator.done: An enrolment link for the new phone went to the recovery address registered to the account. The old phone keeps working until the new one is enrolled.

OW-EMP-1042.registered_device: the Orchard Works Authenticator app on the phone registered to Tara Brennan
OW-EMP-1042.why: The caller who is who she says she is: the prompt on her own phone is approved.

OW-EMP-1107.registered_device: the Orchard Works Authenticator app on the phone registered to Daniel Frost
OW-EMP-1107.why: A second genuine caller, so a request for another employee has a real subject.
